# Knowledge map: USB stack inside the emulators

<!-- Generated by `python -m tools.research.knowledge_map build` from `docs/map/sources/usb-emulated.toml`. Do not edit by hand. -->

- **Scope:** Original UsbControl/OSAL message paths, SETCONFIG delivery, bus-power lanes, QEMU USB cable, VBUS, FUSB, DWC3 and EP0 models, the USB key inhibit and ModelCamera readiness.
- **Evidence span:** see record index; last reviewed 2026-11-22.
- **Deep review:** 44 of 44 records read in full and checked claim by claim ([curation plan](CURATION_PLAN.md)); the rest are curated from titles, lead paragraphs and consolidated documents.
- **Status legend:** PHYSICAL = observed on the camera/host; OFFLINE = disassembly, Unicorn or static proof; INFERENCE = argued from evidence, not observed directly; RETRACTED/REFUTED = do not rely on, kept to prevent re-derivation.

The evidence records are authoritative; follow the links before acting on a claim.

## Frontier

### <a id="f01"></a>F01 - Stock USB startup inside the emulators

- **State:** `open`
- **Next:** Reach authentic still-recording initialization/release so the original clear helper lifts the reason-0x11 inhibit; qualify native OTG/class/gadgetcore startup, then original event production, SETCONFIG and teardown. No injected USB event or ready flag.
- **Evidence:** [E0613](../evidence/0613-original-usb-key-inhibit-owner-and-release-boundary.md), [E0619](../evidence/0619-native-usb-release-model-camera-readiness.md), [E0654](../evidence/0654-usb-stock-attach-and-fusb-start-guard.md), [E0655](../evidence/0655-qemu-first-view-ptp-and-native-dwc3-reset.md)

## Entities

### <a id="proc-usbcontrol"></a>UsbControl service and its FSM

`proc.usbcontrol` | process

Original UsbControl message handler: inbound ObjMsg dispatch, MsgId2EventId map and the USB FSM (SETCONFIG -> event 0x13 -> 0x0A4002 broadcast).

Aliases: `0x00CA8192`, `MsgId2EventId`, `event 0x13`, `0x0A4002`

Current knowledge:

- **C01** `OFFLINE` UsbControl inbound dispatch, the MsgId2EventId map, the ObjMsg layout, ParamMap containers and the serialized wire format were decoded. ([E0323](../evidence/0323-usbcontrol-msgid-eventid-map.md), [E0324](../evidence/0324-mwf-objmsg-layout.md), [E0325](../evidence/0325-mwf-param-parammap-layout.md), [E0326](../evidence/0326-mwf-typed-param-and-serializer-header.md), [E0327](../evidence/0327-mwf-objmsg-wire-format.md))
- **C04** `OFFLINE` A local-queue SETCONFIG post reaches the USB FSM (event 0x13) and completes to the 0x0A4002 broadcast; the original local sync-to-async route runs end to end in isolation with balanced heap/mutex fixtures. ([E0335](../evidence/0335-local-queue-setconfig-reaches-fsm-event-0x13.md), [E0337](../evidence/0337-emulator-uvc-ptp-preparation-and-0a4002-broadcast.md), [E0524](../evidence/0524-original-local-osal-setconfig-route.md))
- **C05** `OFFLINE` Original-process configure/start commands reach FSM 1 -> 5 -> 6 -> 7 and create a bus-power gadget registration record; createGadget stops at the unanswered OTG SET_MODE 0x4001E30C (mode 2), created=0. ([E0534](../evidence/0534-original-process-usb-gadget-registration-and-otg-boundary.md))
- **C07** `OFFLINE` QEMU delivers cable changes to the original FUSB handler; the port monitor sends attach/detach to UsbControl through the local synchronous send path; PostMsg handoff and the ProcessMsg SetJackStatus suppression gate (event 9 / jack 2) were identified. ([E0579](../evidence/0579-qemu-usb-and-sensor-observation.md), [E0580](../evidence/0580-qemu-usb-vbus-interrupt.md), [E0581](../evidence/0581-qemu-vbus-port-and-userspace-delivery.md), [E0582](../evidence/0582-qemu-usb-port-monitor-queue.md), [E0583](../evidence/0583-qemu-usb-local-sync-send.md), [E0584](../evidence/0584-qemu-usb-postmsg-and-processmsg.md), [E0585](../evidence/0585-qemu-usb-jack2-suppression.md))
- **C09** `OFFLINE` The QEMU USB mode gate runs through DefRootView::ActionOpenUSB and StartGadget (0x0A2000). On the DWC3 model the guest never starts the gadget, and a separate helper cannot reach OTG SET_MODE(2) while the stock application runs: opening /dev/usb/otgcore returns EBUSY (errno 16) in three runs. ([E0589](../evidence/0589-qemu-usb-mode-gate-and-defrootview.md), [E0593](../evidence/0593-qemu-dwc3-virtual-host-and-gadget-start-gap.md), [E0594](../evidence/0594-qemu-otg-exclusive-open-boundary.md))
- **C11** `OFFLINE` Through an identity-checked diagnostic mod, original USB service commands run in the captured process; the first run's CUsbSvc state 7 turned out to be the E305 -EBUSY error path. Modelling the unimplemented F0200024 bit-0 guard (with a physical read-only snapshot) lets original SET_MODE(2) and gadget create succeed (state 3, created=1), and GET_DESCRIPTOR returns the bus-power DEVICE descriptor 054C:096F. With strict token-driven EP0 the host completes six standard transfers including SET_ADDRESS, SET_CONFIGURATION and GET_CONFIGURATION=1. The function is bus-power/HID, not UVC. ([E0596](../evidence/0596-qemu-original-usb-service-startup.md), [E0597](../evidence/0597-qemu-original-gadget-start-and-device-descriptor.md), [E0598](../evidence/0598-qemu-token-driven-ep0-configuration.md))
- **C14** `OFFLINE` A console log sink, the message-teardown boundary and the /dev/usb/event map were recorded. ([E0338](../evidence/0338-tty-log-sink-teardown-and-usb-event-map.md))

Do not rely on:

- ~~An emulated SETCONFIG ObjMsg can be delivered to UsbControl through the kernel UIPC receive queue 0x00CA8192.~~ **R02** `REFUTED` ([E0328](../evidence/0328-emulated-setconfig-objmsg-injection-and-osal-gap.md)); see C02: Queue IDs with bit 15 (UsbControl 0x00CA8192, UsbBusPower 0x012182EB, BusPower 0x012282F6) route through process-local queue objects and FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE, not kernel UIPC ioctls; the emulated SETCONFIG envelope was first not consumed for that reason. *Note: E0329-E0331: ids with bit 15 set are process-local queue objects that only in-process senders reach.*

### <a id="proc-osal-queues"></a>OSAL queue lanes (local vs kernel sync callback)

`proc.osal-queues` | process

Queue IDs with bit 15 use process-local user-space queues plus FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE; kernel sync queues 0x00CA0288 (h4109, adjustment) and 0x00CA01A4 (h4110, input) are separate lanes.

Aliases: `bit-15 queue`, `h4109`, `h4110`, `FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE`

Current knowledge:

- **C02** `OFFLINE` Queue IDs with bit 15 (UsbControl 0x00CA8192, UsbBusPower 0x012182EB, BusPower 0x012282F6) route through process-local queue objects and FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE, not kernel UIPC ioctls; the emulated SETCONFIG envelope was first not consumed for that reason. ([E0328](../evidence/0328-emulated-setconfig-objmsg-injection-and-osal-gap.md), [E0329](../evidence/0329-libosal-receive-queue-protocol.md), [E0330](../evidence/0330-libosal-queue-object-layout.md), [E0331](../evidence/0331-usb-lane-local-queue-vs-sync-callback.md))
- **C03** `OFFLINE` Kernel-originated delivery to sync-registered callbacks invokes original callbacks; the h4109 lane is the USB adjustment channel (320-byte OsalRequestPacket) and h4110 the input callback, neither a SETCONFIG lane. ([E0332](../evidence/0332-sync-callback-delivery-first-invocation.md), [E0333](../evidence/0333-sync-callback-packet-format.md), [E0334](../evidence/0334-sync-callback-lane-is-usb-adjustment.md))

Do not rely on:

- ~~The kernel sync-callback lane (0x00CA0288, handle 4109) is the inbound SETCONFIG delivery path.~~ **R01** `REFUTED` ([E0332](../evidence/0332-sync-callback-delivery-first-invocation.md)); see C03: Kernel-originated delivery to sync-registered callbacks invokes original callbacks; the h4109 lane is the USB adjustment channel (320-byte OsalRequestPacket) and h4110 the input callback, neither a SETCONFIG lane. *Note: E0334: that lane is the USB adjustment channel and expects a 320-byte OsalRequestPacket.*
- ~~An emulated SETCONFIG ObjMsg can be delivered to UsbControl through the kernel UIPC receive queue 0x00CA8192.~~ **R02** `REFUTED` ([E0328](../evidence/0328-emulated-setconfig-objmsg-injection-and-osal-gap.md)); see C02: Queue IDs with bit 15 (UsbControl 0x00CA8192, UsbBusPower 0x012182EB, BusPower 0x012282F6) route through process-local queue objects and FUTEX_WAKE_PRIVATE, not kernel UIPC ioctls; the emulated SETCONFIG envelope was first not consumed for that reason. *Note: E0329-E0331: ids with bit 15 set are process-local queue objects that only in-process senders reach.*

### <a id="proc-buspower"></a>Bus-power lanes and libBusPower FSM

`proc.buspower` | process | inventory `firmware.elf:nflasha15_unpacked/lib/libBusPower.so`

The bus-power 0x012002DA lane and libBusPower FSM driven by VBUS.

Current knowledge:

- **C06** `OFFLINE` The buspower 0x012002DA lane is a power lane, not the USB-connect path; VBUS wakes the proxies without a USB FSM transition in the live 8.2.6.0 replay. ([E0310](../evidence/0310-team-cycle-buspower-lane-and-second-path.md), [E0318](../evidence/0318-live-826-service-idle-and-vbus-injection.md), [E0303](../evidence/0303-usb-uipc-otgcore-uvc-ptp-readiness.md), [E0304](../evidence/0304-preboundary-usb-injection-and-vbus-delivery.md))
- **C08** `OFFLINE` FUSB bit 1 (0xF2920010) drives CID kevent subtype 0; opt-in usb-cid-high unlocks SetJackStatus(1,1) and the 0x0A400A/B broadcast; QMP VBUS then drives the libBusPower FSM while UsbControl stays in STOP. ([E0586](../evidence/0586-qemu-usb-cid-bit1-and-otg-kevent.md), [E0587](../evidence/0587-qemu-usb-cid-high-unlocks-vbus-broadcast.md), [E0588](../evidence/0588-qemu-usb-buspower-and-obj-fsm-dispatch.md))

([E0586](../evidence/0586-qemu-usb-cid-bit1-and-otg-kevent.md), [E0587](../evidence/0587-qemu-usb-cid-high-unlocks-vbus-broadcast.md), [E0588](../evidence/0588-qemu-usb-buspower-and-obj-fsm-dispatch.md))
- **C10** `PHYSICAL` Two read-only MSC samples from the physical camera back an opt-in DWC3 GHWPARAMS profile and a connected-state snapshot; this qualifies identity registers, not capabilities or transfers. ([E0595](../evidence/0595-dwc3-physical-hardware-parameter-profile.md), [E0597](../evidence/0597-qemu-original-gadget-start-and-device-descriptor.md))
- **C11** `OFFLINE` Through an identity-checked diagnostic mod, original USB service commands run in the captured process; the first run's CUsbSvc state 7 turned out to be the E305 -EBUSY error path. Modelling the unimplemented F0200024 bit-0 guard (with a physical read-only snapshot) lets original SET_MODE(2) and gadget create succeed (state 3, created=1), and GET_DESCRIPTOR returns the bus-power DEVICE descriptor 054C:096F. With strict token-driven EP0 the host completes six standard transfers including SET_ADDRESS, SET_CONFIGURATION and GET_CONFIGURATION=1. The function is bus-power/HID, not UVC. ([E0596](../evidence/0596-qemu-original-usb-service-startup.md), [E0597](../evidence/0597-qemu-original-gadget-start-and-device-descriptor.md), [E0598](../evidence/0598-qemu-token-driven-ep0-configuration.md))
- **C13** `OFFLINE` With the stock P display, VBUS reaches the original jack handler but starts no DWC3 gadget; early native cable delivery passes FirstView checks and a stock Play press restores ModelCamera readiness, yet USB stays suppressed with reason 0x11. The Unicorn E305 replay enters the bound DWC3 reset and stops before the PL310 sync write. ([E0654](../evidence/0654-usb-stock-attach-and-fusb-start-guard.md), [E0655](../evidence/0655-qemu-first-view-ptp-and-native-dwc3-reset.md))

### <a id="proc-usb-key-inhibit"></a>USB key inhibit and ModelCamera readiness

`proc.usb-key-inhibit` | process

Original application gate: startup natively inhibits USB physical key 0x07000001 and I-InputMain suppresses it with reason 0x11 until still-recording readiness.

Aliases: `0x07000001`, `reason 0x11`, `@M001`

Current knowledge:

- **C12** `OFFLINE` Original USB attach/detach reaches I-InputRecv (0x007A0020) and I-InputMain (0x007A804C); startup inhibits USB physical key 0x07000001 and I-InputMain suppresses it with reason 0x11; binding group 1 gets not-ready replies from ModelCamera (0x0B) while ModelStillRec (0x0F) is ready. ([E0611](../evidence/0611-qemu-usb-input-chain-identity-boundary.md), [E0612](../evidence/0612-captured-usb-receive-and-ready-gate.md), [E0613](../evidence/0613-original-usb-key-inhibit-owner-and-release-boundary.md), [E0619](../evidence/0619-native-usb-release-model-camera-readiness.md))
- **C13** `OFFLINE` With the stock P display, VBUS reaches the original jack handler but starts no DWC3 gadget; early native cable delivery passes FirstView checks and a stock Play press restores ModelCamera readiness, yet USB stays suppressed with reason 0x11. The Unicorn E305 replay enters the bound DWC3 reset and stops before the PL310 sync write. ([E0654](../evidence/0654-usb-stock-attach-and-fusb-start-guard.md), [E0655](../evidence/0655-qemu-first-view-ptp-and-native-dwc3-reset.md))
